concerns.text: The plan falls back to the placeholder dataset `https://huggingface.co/datasets/khaoula-ghz/guanaco-llama2-5k/resolve/main/data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet` when the intended metabolomics repositories are unavailable. This dataset contains language‑model training data, not plant metabolomics or herbivory measurements, and therefore cannot satisfy FR‑001 (paired metabolite–herbivory data for ≥ 50 plant species). Using it makes the analysis a proof‑of‑concept that does not address the research question, violating the requirement for an appropriate biological dataset.
